en.headline: Government books HK$19 billion deficit after five months
en.dek: Spending outpaced receipts to end-August as salaries and profits tax have yet to come in; fiscal reserves stood at HK$646.5 billion.
body: The government said on Wednesday that the first five months of the 2026-27 financial year, to 31 August, recorded a deficit of about HK$19.0 billion after bond issuance and repayment.

Overall expenditure was HK$311.0 billion and revenue HK$249.2 billion. After counting HK$56.2 billion raised from government bonds and HK$13.4 billion of principal repaid, the consolidated accounts showed a deficit of HK$18.99 billion. A government spokesman said the shortfall at this point in the year was mainly seasonal, because salaries tax and profits tax are largely collected later in the financial year.

Fiscal reserves stood at HK$646.6 billion at the end of August. Government debt was put at HK$455.5 billion, with a further HK$105.2 billion of government-guaranteed debt. The land fund balance of about HK$249.8 billion remains inside the Future Fund for long-term investment.
The figures were released in the monthly statement of the government's consolidated accounts covering the General Revenue Account and eight funds.

zh.headline: 政府首五個月錄約190億元赤字
zh.dek: 截至8月底開支3,110億、收入2,492億，計入發債及還債後赤字約190億；財政儲備6466億。
body: 政府星期三公布，2026至27財政年度首五個月（截至8月31日），計入發行及償還政府債券後錄得約190億港元赤字。
期內整體開支3,110億元，收入2,492億元。計入發行政府債券所得562億元及償還本金134億元後，綜合帳目赤字約189.9億元。政府發言人表示，截至8月出現赤字，主要因為薪俸稅及利得稅等主要收入大多在財政年度較後時間才收取，屬季節性現象。
8月底財政儲備為6466億元。政府債項4555億元，政府保證債項1052億元。土地基金結餘約2498億元已納入「未來基金」作長期投資。
數字來自政府一般收入帳目及八個基金的綜合帳目月報。
